_readme: Source of truth for events.html. Add a new event by copying an existing object. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. Events dated today or later show under Upcoming; earlier dates move to Past Events automatically. Set "status" to "upcoming" or "past" to override. Set "registration" to null when there is no sign-up link, and "recording" to null when there is no video.

events.title: Fireside Chat featuring Duolingo
events.speaker: Severin Hacker
events.description: Severin Hacker, co-founder of Duolingo, joins 99 Tartans Alumni Angels at Carnegie Mellon University's Swartz Center for Entrepreneurship for a conversation on technology, entrepreneurship, and the journey of building a global learning platform. From Duolingo’s beginnings at Carnegie Mellon to its mission of making education accessible to everyone, the conversation explores the intersection of learning, innovation, and company building. Hear Severin's perspective on the evolving role of artificial intelligence in education and the opportunities ahead for founders creating products with global impact. Watch the full interview and subscribe for more conversations with leaders shaping the future of technology and entrepreneurship.

events.title: Fireside Chat featuring Aurora Innovation
events.speaker: Chris Urmson
events.description: Chris Urmson, co-founder and CEO of Aurora Innovation, joins 99 Tartans Alumni Angels for a conversation on the future of autonomous transportation and the decades-long journey to bring self-driving technology into the real world. Urmson reflects on his early work leading Google’s self-driving car program, the founding of Aurora, and the technical and regulatory challenges of deploying autonomous trucks at scale. Hear how Aurora approaches safety and commercialization, why trucking is the first major market for autonomy, and what the next phase of transportation innovation may look like. Watch the full interview and subscribe for more conversations with leaders shaping the future of technology and entrepreneurship.
